expectations.text: Identifies the per-frame allocations in step(): the { value: ... } object, and the this.slides.map(...).filter(...) chain that builds a new array and spread-clones slide objects every frame
expectations.evidence: names {value} wrapper + map+filter+spread ~8 obj/2 arr/2 closures per frame

expectations.text: Explains that per-frame allocation creates GC pressure that manifests as jank/stutter on low-end TV hardware while being invisible on a dev machine
expectations.evidence: small TV heap, stop-the-world minor GC lands mid-fade

expectations.text: The fix removes allocation from the loop: reuse hoisted scratch values and index into this.slides directly (e.g. this.slides[this.current]) instead of map+filter
expectations.evidence: direct index this.slides[this.current], module-level helpers, no map/filter

expectations.text: Notes that only cheap properties (opacity / transform) should be animated per frame, and/or that reassigning the image src mid-fade forces a texture re-upload each advance so both slide textures should be kept/preloaded
expectations.evidence: idle between transitions, src only on swap, preload + img.decode()

expectations.text: Does not misattribute the jank solely to the fade math constant or to needing a faster device, without addressing the allocation in the frame loop
